title: EPIC-175 JSON 注入 MEDIUM 修复 — automation-monitor-todos.sh 用 jq 替代 printf 拼 JSON
description:
EPIC-175-fix — 修 EPIC-175 commit `d40e5a7` security review 抓的 2 个 MEDIUM JSON 注入.

**Context**: security-guidance plugin review `scripts/automation-monitor-todos.sh`:
- MEDIUM #1: `entry=$(printf '{"ts":"%s"..."payload":%s}' "$ts" "$event_type" "$ticket_id" "$payload")` — JSON injection risk
- MEDIUM #2: `emit_event "automation-monitor" "$ticket_id" "{\"status\":\"$status\"}"` — JSON injection risk

**修法** (跟 EPIC-168-BG 修 EPIC-166 1:1 pattern):
- 用 `jq -n` 替代 printf 拼 JSON
- 安全 escape 特殊字符
- 加 integration test 覆盖 injection 攻击 case

**0 改 source code 之外** (本 EPIC 修 EPIC-175 实施产物, 跟 EPIC-175 1:1)
**0 增 Rule**
acceptance: AC1: 修 MEDIUM #1 — emit_event 用 jq -n 安全构造 JSON
AC2: 修 MEDIUM #2 — monitor 内部 status payload 用 jq -n 安全构造
AC3: tests/integration/automation-monitor-json-injection.test.sh ≥4 case PASS (normal / single quote / double quote / newline injection)
AC6: 0 改 source code 之外, 0 增 Rule, 0 增 immutable script
rule_references: EPIC-168-BG (修 review 抓 bug 1:1 pattern)
